raw_reasoning:
Explain your reasoning in 2 to 4 sentences. Consider whose data or rights are affected, and whether they would reasonably expect to be asked first.

The proposed action involves processing personal data (library borrowing records identifying users with overdue books) and sending external notifications to those specific users. Affected users have a reasonable expectation of being notified about overdue items as part of standard library services, and the inclusion of a one-click opt-out respects their ability to control future communications without requiring upfront permission for this functional reminder. This aligns with typical implicit or opt-out consent models for service-related notifications rather than needing explicit consent beforehand. No sensitive rights appear to be overridden.
